channels.topic:
**__Hacking Battlegrounds__** is a  player-versus-player experience in Hack The Box! Join your friends or meet new friends as you get together in groups of 4 or 2 and fight for  flags. 

How to improve your HBG experience? Speak Up: https://bit.ly/3gQWPrK

**Cyber Mayhem**
Players are split into two teams and compete in timed battles. Two sets of machines are spawned and assigned to each team. Players are given root access to their team's machines and are tasked to secure them while trying to attack the opposing team's machines. 

**Server Siege**
One set of machines is spawned and two teams compete over who hacks the machines first. Once hacked, the team should secure their position to the machine and race to get the root flag.

Cybernetics LLC, a robot manufacturing company, needs your assistance! You are a consultant that was brought in to perform a red team assessment on the Cybernetics environment. Your objective is to establish a foothold and pivot through the internal environment and acquire domain administrator privileges in all domains.

What you will learn?
Cybernetics Pro Lab is an immersive Windows Active Directory environment that has gone through various pentest engagements in the past, and therefore has upgraded Operating Systems, applied all patches and hardened the underlying operating systems. Here is what is included:

Web application attacks
Kerberos abuse
Active Directory enumeration and exploitation
Phishing
Privilege escalation
Lateral movement
Evading endpoint protections

channels.topic:
APTLabs simulates a targeted attack by an external threat agent against an MSP (Managed Service Provider). The lab requires prerequisite knowledge of attacking Active Directory networks. APTLabs consists of fully patched servers, prevalent enterprise technologies, a simulated WAN network, and much more!

Your goal is to compromise all client networks and reach Domain Admin wherever possible. On completion of this lab, you will be familiar with long-lasting TTPs, how to attack enterprise technology, and be a true Google-ninja.

On completion of the APTLabs, players will have learned a range of Red Team TTPs (Tools, Techniques, Procedures), and gained experience in the following areas:

This Red Team Operator Level III lab will expose players to:
- Active Directory Enumeration and Exploitation
- Ability to compromise networks without using any CVEs
- Bypassing Common Security Features such as 2FA
- Exploiting Interactive Users
- Kerberos Attacks
- Lateral Movement
- Privilege Escalation
- Situational Awareness
channels.name: prolabs-aptlabs

channels.topic:
**Primary bots:**
Moderation: 

**Ban - Administrator**
Usage: ++ban @user123 Being Stupid
What it does: Bans user

**TempBan - Moderator**
Usage: ++tempban @tobu 1w Spamming
What it does: Bans user for X Time, Only Doable in 30s Intervals

**UnBan - Administrator**
Usage: ++unban 536734459563737090
What it does: Unbans user with that ID

**Kick - Moderator**
Usage: ++kick @user123 Stupid
What it does: Kicks User

**Say - Moderator**
Usage: ++say #general uwu
What it does: You speak from bot.

**Mute - Moderator**
Usage: ++mute @BelleDelphine 6m UwU
What it does: Mute X person for Y time

**slowmode - Moderator**
Usage: ++setdelay 5
what it does: Sets slowmode to X in the channel.

**Badname - Moderator**
Usage: ++badname @example123
What it does: Gives user a randomly generated name.

**Nick - Moderator**
Usage: ++nick @example123 Jeffery
What it does: Sets user to nick provided

**Nuke - Moderator**
Usage: ++nuke 123
What it does: Removes past X(123 in this case) messages from the channel it was used in.

The team is concerned that any actual breach could lead to a loss of earnings and reputation damage. Upon breaching the perimeter, you are required to explore the network, moving laterally and vertically, until you gain administrative control over all hosts and reach domain admin.

What you will learn?
Dante Pro Lab is a captivating environment that features both Linux and Windows Operating Systems. You will level up your skills in information gathering and situational awareness, be able to exploit Windows and Linux buffer overflows, gain familiarity with the Metasploit Framework, and much more! Completion of this lab will demonstrate your skills in network penetration testing.

This Penetration Tester Level I lab will expose players to:

Enumeration
Exploit Development
Lateral Movement
Privilege Escalation
Web Application Attacks
